metric: PPM standardized within season on eligible full roster with sample SD
population: all colleges, final eligible observed season; maximum minutes team if needed
binning: floor((rank(method=first)-1)*16/N); no tying together or outcome-based ordering
reference_reproduction: all counts, rates, performance means and medians match within 1e-12

display_style.title: Higher performance is associated with a higher draft rate
display_style.note: Display settings only. Cohort and 16 reference bins are verified in build_figure.py; changing bin definitions requires a separately documented analysis.

comparison_limit: Different years and bin count from earlier Jazz 2011–2021/Q8; this reproduces the chosen historical anchor, not a one-factor comparison.
